title: Stone Island Ghost 4100044 cotton canvas jacket
story: Stone Island’s Ghost Piece dyes the compass badge into the cloth, so the mark only reads up close. Style 4100044 is the grey all-weather cotton canvas jacket. Farfetch’s text, read on 21 October 2026, describes a knit stand collar, knit sleeves and hem, flap pockets, a concealed two-way zip, and the Ghost badge on the left sleeve. The composition on that page is organic cotton for the outer and virgin wool for the rib. The listing was open at $1,450 with duties included, an Add to Bag control, and delivery from 26 October to 2 November 2026. A size selector was on the page; in-stock sizes and the boutique name were not. No run size is published for 4100044. The Farfetch frame is a model, so the rail uses Bloomingdale’s UAE ghost-mannequin packshot of the same light-grey jacket. Sources: Farfetch item 34030355 and Bloomingdale’s UAE CLO219203135, both checked 21 October 2026.

story: This is the black polyester Moncler x Palm Angels jacket listed by Giovanni in Italy on Vestiaire Collective, reference 72059216.
